parsed.attack: The invited party is the supervising parent, who is not a user but a countersigner being handed an obligation, and the pair is closed - the parent will never invite anyone, so the coefficient is capped at one hop by construction, not by execution. The need then self-destructs on a scheduled date: the learner passes the practical test, both parties uninstall, and the base turns over annually with zero retained advocates, because nobody who has passed has any occasion to mention a practice log again. A one-time purchase removes the only repair, since there is no recurring revenue to fund a two-sided referral and paid acquisition at $20-$80 per payer is far above the ticket.
parsed.strongest_defence: Learner drivers are densely co-located in sixth forms and colleges and compete openly on progress, so a visible unbroken streak is a social object among peers who all need the same thing in the same term - a school-corridor cycle time of days - and 'driving practice log' is a cheap, largely uncontested App Store search in a market every UK 17-year-old enters.
parsed.verdict_reason: The functional invite reaches exactly one non-propagating parent and the whole base self-terminates at the driving test, so the loop cannot compound even when the invite works.
